name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. On an inbox task every non-closing answer asks where it goes before writing and moves there. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a dated entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F ask for an optional Work Log summary before refreshing Pending tasks. On a landed RECURRING row both write nothing, show the recurring-tier notice, and stay. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3). `]s` / `[s` away from the current review task first return to it. The Task Card level strip and priority notices render the shared signal-bar priority mark through the bob-ledger-tools api.priorityMarks v1 namespace, falling back to the Lucide signal icons without it. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress — asking once for an optional Work Log summary when moving back to Next — through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace. Closing a planned task links what it unblocked into its slot and reports it on the Unblocked card through the nav api.notice v1 namespace. Review-row closes append the cycler's additive `successorNotice` line to the walk toast.
author: Bryan
